thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — ran a micro smoke on a few runtime pages and found 3 small issues, posting them here so owners can claim:
- runtime/pinning-models.md: anchor mismatch, deep-link to #pinning-policy 404s in TOC
- assets/images/flow.png returns 410 from CDN intermittently (noticed in staging preview)
- examples/curl/predict.md references /v1/old-endpoint which is deprecated and fails curl smoke-tests

Maya: curl output for the old endpoint:
```
$ curl -sv https://api.internal.redwood.dev/v1/old-endpoint
* Connected to api.internal.redwood.dev (10.10.10.10) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/old-endpoint HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.internal.redwood.dev
> 
< HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
< content-type: application/json
< 
{"error":"endpoint_deprecated","message":"use /v1/predict"}
```

Maya: @Oliver R any chance you own pinning-models? If not I can open a tiny PR to rename the anchor to match the TOC. :pray:

Oliver R: I own the pinning guide. I'll take the anchor fix.

Oliver R: quick plan — I'll: 1) add a redirect anchor in the MD 2) update the TOC reference if needed 3) open PR with short description. ETA tomorrow morning.

Samir: I can handle the flow.png rehost. Saw the CDN returning 410 on staging yesterday too. I'll reupload to /assets/docs-hosted/ and update the img path.

Maya: thanks Samir — if you rehost can you also gzip-opt the PNGs? small win for the guide.

Samir: yep. Will optimize and include a small note in the PR body (original -> rehosted, optimized).

Maya: for the deprecated endpoint in examples/curl, I sketched a one-liner to replace occurrences across the examples dir (safe sed, creates branch):
```bash
git checkout -b fix/docs-curl-endpoint-2023
rg "v1/old-endpoint" -n --hidden --glob "!node_modules" | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -I{} sed -i '' 's@/v1/old-endpoint@/v1/predict@g' {}
```

Maya: I can open the PR if no one claims it.

Oliver R: please do open the PR, tag me for review. I'll fast-track the anchor redirect. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: New PR opened by Maya — fix/docs-curl-endpoint-2023 (#4872) — 3 files changed.

deploy-bot: staging docs deploy succeeded (build 4521) — https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/runtime/pinning-models (served from region eu-west-1) :white_check_mark:

Maya: awesome. tagging @docs-librarian for record/ownership. If anyone needs me to split the PRs (one for curl, one for images), say so — happy to split.

Samir: optional split would be nice but not required. I'll coordinate PR for the image rehost and link to Maya's PR.

Maya: cool. closing my checklist for now — will follow up on PR comments. Thanks all. :sparkles:
